title: AI硬件股回撤50%：基本面仍强，30到50倍估值还能撑住吗？
speaker: Matty Jiao

segments.en: How do you see that I mean we're just talking about some pretty steep moves across some of the AI hardware space in China right now I think we're like 50% off the peaks of some of these stocks when it comes to the optalings and the like.
segments.zh: 你怎么看？我们刚谈到中国AI硬件领域一些大幅波动，部分光模块等个股较峰值回落约50%。

segments.en: Yeah does that be do you think it's overdone in some ways I mean the fundamentals are still looking pretty strong it seems.
segments.zh: 是的，你认为某些方面是否过度了？基本面似乎依然相当强劲。

segments.en: Yes I think I think the fundamental is still looks quite strong some of the area the tightness is still quite severe as well I think the there are quite a few concerned one is like the cat packs I mean how much funding is available versus how much cat packs is needed is one of the concern right we have a lot of the magazine company come out to raise
segments.zh: 是的，我认为基本面依然相当强劲，部分领域供应紧张仍较严重。有几个担忧，比如资本开支：可用资金与所需资本开支的匹配是担忧之一。许多公司融资引发市场担忧。

segments.en: some money that's caused market concern as well and of course like the US born you has been increasing the cost of funding is increasing as well I think those were key concerns on the market that maybe the cat packs will not be growing as fast as people thoughts that's why our cat packs come from the funding needs or funding availability and then I think another thing is in the past people has been also expecting ASP increase for a lot of the products.
segments.zh: 当然，美国利率上升推高融资成本。这些是市场关键担忧：资本开支增速可能不及预期，源于融资需求与可用性。另外，过去人们预期许多产品均价提升。

segments.en: We are starting to see some area we are starting to see threats of ASP stabilizing or not increasing as fast as possible as well.
segments.zh: 我们开始看到部分领域均价趋稳或增速放缓的迹象。

segments.en: I would say thirdly it's also multiple multiple revisions right people have been worried about a lot of the concern we just mentioned about so in the past people may be willing to pay 30 to 50 times for attack company now this multiple has derated quite a lot.
segments.zh: 第三是估值倍数下调。人们担忧我们提到的因素。过去愿意给30到50倍估值，现在倍数已大幅下降。

segments.en: Yeah I mean almost it almost reversed completely I think we had this conversation 10 months ago it's as if we were talking about very very different company so about it given the that nothing has changed within 10 months say on the the supply constraints whether that's in copper or other places is this a good opportunity to look at these names again.
segments.zh: 几乎完全逆转。10个月前对话仿佛在谈不同公司。鉴于10个月内供应约束未变，无论是铜还是其他领域，这是否是重新关注这些标的的好机会？
